title: GCEV controlled-evaluation manuscript evidence ledger
path_base: Repository root; all file paths below are repository-relative.
purpose: Identify the actual documentary inputs and saved results used for the manuscript, preserve their byte identity, and link bounded claims to those inputs.

completion_state.DOCX_formatting_and_visual_review: complete; all 22 PDF pages visually checked
completion_state.final_user_delivery: editable DOCX and reviewed PDF made available as the manuscript review package

data_access_boundary.read_to_prepare_ledger: Explicitly listed protocols, experiment reports, manifests, aggregate saved metrics and manuscript summary tables only.
excluded: All expression matrices and raw observations, including reserved K562 test cells
Raw perturbation or binding outcome payloads and sealed biological labels
Synthetic expression, generating reference-edge payloads and per-edge ranking payloads
Raw sequencing/peak files and entire experiment archives
Mutable manuscript/DOCX/PDF outputs and this ledger itself
data_access_boundary.existing_synthetic_test_metric_policy: Previously saved aggregate test-NMSE values are retained as published experiment summaries; no test-expression observations were reopened.
data_access_boundary.metadata_reference_policy: A manifest or report may identify a raw input by its historic path or checksum. Such pointers were not dereferenced and do not make that raw payload a ledger input.

interpretation_notes: Locked means a documented repository precommit, not an independently registered trial.
The three synthetic studies have different primary estimands and are not pooled.
Archive-recovered CSVs are complete saved metrics, not regenerated outcomes. All original confidence intervals are retained unchanged.
No-graph-state is a historical method label for the source-feature-only comparator; its source summaries can still depend on scaffold-restricted candidates.
Summary aggregation is descriptive and does not add independent observations.
Scientific gate status is separate from writing progress and document-formatting completion.

claim_source_map.claim: All three synthetic primary success criteria were not met.
claim_source_map.scope: Separately locked primary estimands; no pooled primary claim.

claim_source_map.claim: The 48-network study has eleven methods, with full AP, AUROC, precision-at-seven, direction/tie and test-NMSE results retained.
claim_source_map.scope: Synthetic metrics only; fixed_sources and legacy fixed are different controls; favorable secondary AP contrasts are retained.

claim_source_map.claim: The three saved seed sets are disjoint: 48 plus 32 plus 32 independently seeded DAG realizations and 8,256 method outputs.
claim_source_map.scope: 112 simulator realizations, not 704 independent repeated conditions, unique topologies, biological datasets or a pooled inferential sample.

claim_source_map.claim: Synthetic uncertainty resamples whole DAG units and respects paired mechanisms; priors were constructed from simulated truth.
claim_source_map.scope: Oracle-derived priors; biological source independence is not demonstrated.

claim_source_map.claim: Cost exports contain shared GCEV fitting metadata duplicated across method rows and a separate greedy query counter.
claim_source_map.scope: Counters from different computational stages do not support matched-total-compute superiority.

claim_source_map.claim: The developmental K562 cohort uses 16 TFs, 48 additional targets and the original 394/131/133 split.
claim_source_map.scope: Motif availability informed a declared developmental redesign; count-like input is not certified raw UMI.

claim_source_map.claim: The final deterministic promoter prior has 517 positive scores, 47 nominal p<0.05 values and zero BH q<0.05 edges.
claim_source_map.scope: Sequence potential is not TF binding; the BIO-V5 report uses an imprecise gene-ID shorthand for the null seed, while the manuscript records the implemented target-symbol seed.

claim_source_map.claim: DNase accessibility is target-level context from one experiment with two biosamples; matched caller versions are processing sensitivities.
claim_source_map.scope: Expression and accessibility cultures differ; assay QC and independent-reference lineage remain incomplete.

claim_source_map.claim: BIO-V7 primary GCEV-minus-source-feature-only NMSE is -0.000223362209366 with an interval spanning zero.
claim_source_map.scope: Conditional 131-cell internal-score bootstrap, not biological replication; the 133 reserved test cells remain unanalysed.

claim_source_map.claim: BIO-V8 source representations can alter choices, but no predictive or biological outcome was evaluated for those altered choices.
claim_source_map.scope: Saved-score diagnosis following known developmental outcomes; multiplicative source products are derived representations, not additional independent assays.

claim_source_map.claim: External ENCODE qualification is incomplete after six HTTP 403 responses and remains NO_GO_FOR_BIOLOGICAL_SCORING.
claim_source_map.scope: Failed access does not establish absence of assays; public binding leads are not qualified edge truth.

claim_source_map.claim: Independent computational audits support deterministic reproduction within the executed settings.
claim_source_map.scope: Computational reproduction is not biological replication and adds no independent sample units.
